entries.detection: Sensed as a 'prying gaze' or subtle spiritual pressure. Free Per roll at +2 when someone actively divines them.
entries.bonusText: Free Per roll at +2 when someone actively divines them.

entries.detection: Feel the disturbance as a cold touch on their Ether Body. Automatic SPI roll to notice.
Instinctive awareness when their secrets are pried into. +2 to detect divination related to their hidden knowledge.
entries.bonusText: +2 to detect divination related to their hidden knowledge.

entries.detection: Always-on spiritual perception. Automatic SPI roll to detect any divination targeting them within 50 meters.
Sense when a law or rule is being broken spiritually. +2 to detect divination as a form of spiritual trespass.
entries.bonusText: +2 to detect divination as a form of spiritual trespass.

entries.detection: Passive luck interference. At the GM's discretion, any divination attempt against a Monster may suffer -1 as random chance skews the result. (Passive, unconscious.)

Free Per roll (no bonus) to detect any divination targeting them. +2 if the divination concerns fate, concealment, or secrets. Lord of the Mysteries pathways gain innate divination awareness as part of their authority.
entries.bonusText: +2 if the divination concerns fate, concealment, or secrets.

entries.detection: Automatic awareness. A demigod always knows when someone of weaker Sequence attempts to divine them. Equal or stronger Sequence requires a Quick Contest of SPI vs the diviner's Divination Arts.
